subject: Re: Redwood SOC 2 / Security follow-up & next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Smith <dylan.smith@zenwellhealth.com>; Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-12T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood SOC 2 / Security follow-up & next steps

Hi Dylan / Alex —

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate the time. Per our discussion, I wanted to summarize the key pain points you called out and confirm next steps so your security and procurement teams have what they need to evaluate Redwood.

Summary of pain points / goals:
- SOC 2 attestation and evidence for our SOC 2 Type II (reports, scope).
- Audit logs: retention policy, access controls, format (raw logs vs. aggregated), and SIEM integrations.
- Data residency and retention (how long user data / KV cache / logs are retained; deletion workflows).
- DPA and commercial terms redlines for enterprise procurement.
- Pen test results / remediation summary for recent assessment.

What we can provide (initial):
- SOC2_Report_2027.pdf (attached) — current attestation + summary of scope.
- PenTest_Summary_2027.zip (attached) — executive summary and remediation tracker.
- DPA_Redwood_v2.docx (attached) — editable DPA draft we typically use with enterprise customers.
- Audit log docs: we can provide both aggregated event feeds and raw log exports; default retention is 90 days, configurable up to 12 months for enterprise with contractual SLAs.

Proposed next steps / ask list:
1) I will share the SOC2 report & pen test summary (attached).
2) Please confirm: preferred retention requirement for audit logs (90 days default vs. 12 months long-term).
3) We should schedule a technical deep-dive with Marissa (CC'd) to walk through audit log formats, SIEM export, and KMS/HSM key management details (30-45m).
4) Alex / procurement: please review the attached DPA and flag redlines; we can send a DocuSign link once you've confirmed the version.

Proposed meeting windows: Tue 9/14 09:00-11:00 PT, Wed 9/15 13:00-15:00 PT. Let us know what works and we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — I'll follow up with calendar/DocuSign once I hear back.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: SOC2_Report_2027.pdf, DPA_Redwood_v2.docx, PenTest_Summary_2027.zip

From: Dylan Smith <dylan.smith@zenwellhealth.com>

Cc: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@zenwellhealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T17:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood SOC 2 / Security follow-up & next steps

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the clear recap and for sending the attachments. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Audit log retention: our security policy prefers 12 months of searchable logs, but we can start with 90 days for production if there is a roadmap to 12 months. Can you confirm whether Redwood supports on-demand exports of raw logs for our SIEM?
- SIEM integration: do you have a supported connector for Splunk/Datadog, or is this typically done via S3 export + ingestion?
- Pen test: appreciate the summary. We'll need a statement of whether any critical issues remain open and an ETA for full remediation if applicable.
- DPA: Alex will take the lead here — he's CC'd. If possible, please send a DocuSign link for the current DPA once you've accepted our minor redlines.

We're aiming to close security review in the week of 9/20 so timeline is a bit tight. Happy to take the technical deep-dive next week; Tue 9/14 09:00 PT would work for us.

Thanks,
Dylan
Director, IT Security | ZenWell
dylan.smith@zenwellhealth.com
+1 (646) 555-0124

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Smith <dylan.smith@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@zenwellhealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-13T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood SOC 2 / Security follow-up & next steps (Technical details)

Hi Dylan —

Following up on Neha's note with technical details ahead of our deep-dive: happy to walk through this in the call. Quick answers to your bullets: 

- Retention: default is 90 days searchable retention. For enterprise (contracted) customers we support up to 12 months of searchable logs behind an SLA. We can also provide encrypted raw log exports (newline-delimited JSON) to an S3 bucket you control on a daily cadence.

- SIEM integration: we have native export tooling (S3 export + prebuilt parsing rules) and partner connectors for Datadog; Splunk customers typically ingest via S3 forwarder. We do not currently provide an out-of-the-box Splunk app, but the S3 export + ingestion pattern is battle-tested.

- Audit log format & access controls: logs include request metadata (timestamp, tenant_id, request_id, model, prompt hash), response meta (tokens generated count), and admin actions (user creation, role changes, key rotations). Access is RBAC-controlled and logged. We can provide a sample (redacted) log file during the call.

- KMS / keys: our control plane supports customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM for encryption-at-rest and supports periodic rotation. We can provide our key management whitepaper during the session.

- Pen test: summary attached includes severity and remediation status. No open Criticals; two High issues were remediated in July 2027 and validated by the assessor (see PenTest_Summary_2027.zip). We can provide an on-record attestation if required.

Next steps I'll take care of before the call:
- Upload a sample redacted audit log + parsing notes to the shared drive (link below).
- Prepare an S3 export example and Splunk ingestion notes.
- Bring our security engineer (Rishi Malhotra) on the call for deep-dive details.

Shared resources: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-SOC2

I'll send a calendar invite for Tue 9/14 09:00 PT and include a 45m slot. If you want the DocuSign link sooner, Neha can route that to procurement after Alex flags any redlines.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Head of Trust & Safety | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: sample_audit_log_redacted.json (will upload), PenTest_Summary_2027.zip, SOC2_Report_2027.pdf
